context.transcript:
In other news, the Hadmonton Mayor's Office reports that the Towns Environmental Awareness Month is off to a great start.
This program aims to educate the public about local environmental issues, especially protecting Hadmonton Beach.
This past week, the Organising Committee has been giving away free beach towels made from 100% recycled materials.
If you'd like one, these great products are available at special kiosks along Hadmonton Beach.
But there aren't many towels left.
And now, on the line is Greg Wilson from the Mayor's Office to give us more information.
Welcome, Greg.
context.transcript_translation:
在其他新闻方面，哈德蒙顿市长办公室报告说，本镇的环境意识月活动开局良好。
该项目旨在向公众普及当地环境问题，特别是保护哈德蒙顿海滩。
上周，组织委员会一直在免费派发由100%回收材料制成的沙滩毛巾。
如果您想要一条，这些优质产品可以在哈德蒙顿海滩沿线的特别展亭购买到。
但剩下的毛巾不多了。
现在，市长办公室的格雷格·威尔逊正在接线，为我们提供更多信息。
欢迎，格雷格。
